/**
 * Image utility helpers for scene capture
 */
const path = require("path");
const crypto = require("crypto");

const ImageUtils = {
  /**
   * Generate a unique filename based on scene name and timestamp
   * @param {string} sceneName - Name of the scene
   * @param {string} format - File extension (png, jpeg, etc.)
   * @param {string} pattern - Naming pattern from config
   * @returns {string} Generated filename
   */
  generateFilename(sceneName, format = "png", pattern = "{scene}_{timestamp}") {
    const sanitized = sceneName
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]/g, "_")    // Sanitize special characters
      .replace(/_+/g, "_")              // Collapse multiple underscores
      .slice(0, 64);                    // Limit filename length

    const timestamp = new Date()
      .toISOString()
      .replace(/[:.]/g, "-")           // Make timestamp filesystem-safe
      .replace("T", "_")
      .replace("Z", "");

    return pattern
      .replace("{scene}", sanitized)
      .replace("{timestamp}", timestamp)
      .concat(`.${format}`);
  },

  /**
   * Compute MD5 hash of a buffer for integrity checks
   * @param {Buffer} buffer - Image buffer
   * @returns {string} MD5 hash string
   */
  computeHash(buffer) {
    return crypto.createHash("md5").update(buffer).digest("hex");
  },

  /**
   * Format bytes into human-readable size string
   * @param {number} bytes - Byte count
   * @returns {string} Formatted size (e.g., "1.24 MB")
   */
  formatBytes(bytes) {
    const units = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB"];
    let value = bytes;
    let unit = 0;

    while (value >= 1024 && unit < units.length - 1) {
      value /= 1024;
      unit++;
    }

    return `${value.toFixed(2)} ${units[unit]}`;
  },

  /**
   * Get MIME type from format string
   * @param {string} format - File format
   * @returns {string} MIME type
   */
  getMimeType(format) {
    const mimeMap = {
      png: "image/png",
      jpeg: "image/jpeg",
      jpg: "image/jpeg",
      webp: "image/webp",
    };
    return mimeMap[format.toLowerCase()] || "application/octet-stream";
  },
};

module.exports = ImageUtils;
